label: A reader on my drive
authored_by: the site, as a starting point — not measured, not surveyed; the first thing to argue with
description: I connected my drive so it could find documents and answer questions about them. My drive has other people's files in it — everything a colleague or a client ever shared — and I did not think about that when I clicked.

notes.write.file.host: refused, and the scope does not grant it
notes.read.credential.host: refused, and nothing enforces it: the key exports are in the same drive

provenance.note: Written on this site as the starting mandate for a connector shape the model site has not published. A mandate is elicited, not measured: this is a first draft written to be argued with. `unstated` is the primitives the mandate names neither way.
